scope: real upstream CLI exercised with the Shenko query template over a synthetic corpus; this is not the compiled Rust adapter or model acceptance result

fixture.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, no spaces, no trailing newline

runtime.isolation: dedicated OBELISK_HOME; every provider root explicitly disabled except the owned synthetic Codex root

observations: published provider-settings defaults to homedir/.obelisk/settings.json and does not implement OBELISK_HOME
version labels alone do not establish compatibility
compatibility_finding.required_behavior: reject an unverified CLI before launching any indexing query

projection_limits.statement: passing these queries is not evidence that FTS covers every original byte or that distributed history is complete

real_model_acceptance.reason: No reachable authorized local-model endpoint in either executor or connected Box; documented local gateways returned HTTP 502/403 and the Tailnet gateway returned HTTP 503 or CONNECT 403. The connected Box reports Tailscale logged out.
real_model_acceptance.claim_limit: No model-accuracy, negative-effect, token-saving, or statistical-efficacy conclusion.
